name: paper_id
description: Stable row identifier assigned during curation.

name: pdf_filename
description: Exact PDF filename in the dataset pdfs folder.

name: paper_title
example_answer: SM-Omics is an automated platform for high-throughput spatial multi-omics

name: doi
description: Digital Object Identifier for the article.

name: species
description: Species represented in the main spatial experiment.
expected_format: Common or Latin species name; semicolon-separate multiple primary species.

name: tissue_or_disease_context
description: Tissue, organ, developmental stage, disease context, or model used for the representative spatial result.
example_answer: mouse brain and colorectal cancer model

name: spatial_platform
description: Spatial transcriptomics or spatial omics platform, method, or algorithm being introduced/applied.

name: spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit
description: Reported spatial resolution, capture unit, bead/pixel/spot size, or single-cell/cell-segmentation status.
expected_format: Value with unit or named capture granularity.
evidence_expectation: Methods, schematic, platform description, or figure caption.

name: main_analysis_output
description: Primary analysis output generated by the platform or method.
expected_format: Short noun phrase such as spatial clusters, cell type map, tissue domains, RNA/protein map.

name: key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding
description: Main spatial biological or benchmarking finding about a tissue domain, cell type, neighborhood, or spatial pattern.
expected_format: Concise sentence grounded in the paper.
evidence_expectation: Requires synthesis of text with spatial maps, captions, or annotated tissue images.
example_answer: Layer-specific cortical domains align with known marker expression.

name: representative_spatial_figure_panel
description: Figure panel containing a spatial map, tissue image, spatial cluster plot, or annotated tissue section for the key finding.
expected_format: Figure panel label such as Fig. 2b.
